blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Recent progress in 3D foundation models has enabled rapid 3D reconstruction and camera calibration by leveraging learned 3D priors from vast amount of spatial data. However, the all-to-all global attention design leads to quadratic complexity and limits long-sequence inference; unconstrained cross-view interactions also can propagate unreliable evidence from occluded or visually similar but geometrically distant views.
In this paper,
We introduce a Masked Geometric Encoder (MGE), which promotes the learning of robust geometric representations under incomplete cross-view context.
During training, MGE strategically drops frame tokens from global attention and distills from a pretrained full-context teacher model. This allows the model to learn an intrinsically richer per-frame representation while providing sufficient intermediate supervision to avoid performance degradation.
Through extensive experiments, we show that MGE leads to much stronger performance under occlusion and doppelganger views while retaining high performance on standard benchmarks. Such a richer frame representation also leads to more effective token reduction during inference. To this end, we develop a novel Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging technique that preserves representative anchor frames while jointly merging redundant tokens from the remaining views. Compared to other efficient inference approaches, we can achieve inference speedup while consistently maintaining higher reconstruction quality, particularly in limited-view settings.
blocks.zh:
3D基础模型的近期进展通过利用从大量空间数据中吸取的3D前身,使得能快速地进行3D重建并进行相机校正. 然而,全方位的全球关注设计导致四相复杂,并限制了长序推论;不受约束的交叉视图交互也可以从被隐蔽或视觉相近但几何相去甚远的观点传播出不可靠的证据.
在本文中,
我们引进了一种蒙面几何编码器(MGE),它促进在不完整的交叉视野下学习强健的几何表示.
在培训期间,MGE从战略角度将框架符号从全球注意力中降下,并从经过预先培训的全文教师模型中提炼出. 这使模型能够了解内在丰富的每个框架代表,同时提供足够的中间监督以避免性能退化。
通过广泛的实验,我们显示,在隔离和二重身观点下,MGE会导致更大的性能,同时保留了标准基准的高性能. 如此丰富的框架代表性也导致在推论中更有效的象征性减少。 为此,我们开发出一款小说"Anchor-Guided"(英语:Anchor-Guided Adapitive sindition)并联技术,保留了代表性锚架,同时联合从其余观点中将多余的地标合并. 与其他高效的推论方法相比,我们可以实现推论加速,同时始终保持更高的重建质量,特别是在有限视野环境下.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Extracting 3D concepts from images is a fundamental research problem in computer vision, with various applications in autonomous driving, geo-localization, augmented and virtual reality, and robotics ( Geiger et al., 2013 ; Arandjelovic et al., 2016 ; Newcombe et al., 2011 ; Mur-Artal et al., 2015 ) . Recent feedforward 3D foundation models ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Wang et al., 2026b ) have substantially advanced this capability. These models jointly estimate camera parameters and dense scene geometry from multiple images in one forward pass. By encoding geometric priors learned from large-scale 3D data, these models produce scene-level predictions without requiring the iterative, scene-specific optimization conventionally used in Structure-from-Motion (SfM) pipelines.
blocks.zh: 从图像中提取3D概念是计算机视觉中的一个基本研究问题,在自主驱动、地缘定位、增强和虚拟现实以及机器人方面有各种应用(Geiger等,2013年;Arandjelovic等,2016年;Newcombe等,2011年;Mur-Artal等,2015年). 最近的Feedforward 3D基础模型(Wang等,2024;Wang等,2025a;Wang等,2026b)已大幅提升了这一能力. 这些模型共同估计相机参数和从多幅图像中从一个前行通道中得到的密集场景几何. 通过从大型3D数据中吸取的几何前缀编码,这些模型产生场景级的预测,而不需要结构自动(SfM)管线中常规使用的迭接,场景特有优化.

blocks.en: Despite impressive progress, scalability and robustness remain important challenges for current 3D foundation models. Conventional encoder design aggregates multi-view information through dense global attention. However, additional observations do not always provide reliable geometric evidence. For example, visually similar but geometrically distinct structures, often referred to as Doppelgangers ( Cai et al., 2023 ) , can induce incorrect associations across views. Furthermore, the computation grows quadratically with the total number of frames, making long sequences increasingly expensive to process.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了令人印象深刻的进展,但目前三维基础模型的可扩展性和稳健性仍然是重大挑战。 常规编码器设计通过密集的全球关注来聚合多视图信息. 然而,额外的观测并不总是提供可靠的几何证据. 例如,视觉上相似但几何特征不同的结构,常被称作"多二重身"(Cai等,2023年)会诱发不同观点的不正确的关联. 此外,计算与框架总数成正比地增长,使长序越来越昂贵。

blocks.en: Conventional SfM pipelines provide explicit mechanisms for dealing with these challenges. COLMAP ( Schönberger and Frahm, 2016 ) constructs a view graph from selected image pairs and geometrically verified correspondences. As such, we can remove redundant or ambiguous matching pairs in the view graph through additional prior ( Schönberger and Frahm, 2016 ; Arandjelovic et al., 2016 ; Berton and Masone, 2025 ; Xiangli et al., 2025 ) , leading to speedup or improved accuracy in calibration. Current 3D foundation models compute all-to-all attention across all frames. Naively removing or sparsifying these global interactions can lead to substantial performance degradation ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Sun et al., 2026 ) , suggesting that the pretrained representations are highly dependent on dense cross-view connectivity. By drawing an analogy between a calibration view graph and global attention, we know that not every frame-to-frame relationship is required or can even hurt in bundle adjustment. This prompts our question: Can 3D foundation models learn a more robust representation to missing frames?
blocks.zh: 常规 SfM管道为应对这些挑战提供了明确的机制。 COLMAP (Schönberger and Frahm, 2016) 从所选的图像对和几何验证的函文中构造出一个视图图. 因此,我们可以通过额外的前置(Schönberger and Frahm,2016;Arandjelovic等,2016;Berton and Masone,2025;Xiangli等,2025)来去除视图图中的冗余或模棱两可的配对,导致校正速度加快或提高精度. 目前3D基础模型计算出所有帧的全向关注. 自然地去除这些全球相互作用或使这些相互作用发生螺旋化,可导致显著性能退化(Wang等人,2026a; Sun等, 2026 ),暗示被预训的表述高度依赖密集的交叉视图连接. 通过在校准视图图和全球关注之间作个类比,我们知道并不是每个帧对帧的关系都是需要的,甚至可能伤害到捆绑调整. 这引起了我们的问题: 3D 基础模型能否对缺失的帧学习更强的表示?

blocks.en: To this end, we introduce Masked Geometric Encoder (MGE), a flexible framework for learning robust geometric representations in feed-forward 3D foundation models. MGE draws inspiration from masked representation learning ( He et al., 2022 ) and teacher–student learning ( Caron et al., 2021 ; Oquab et al., 2023 ) . Instead of masking image content, we randomly remove frame-to-frame connections during global attention, restricting the available cross-view information to the geometric encoder to simulate sparse calibration view graph. Importantly, the underlying scene geometry remains unchanged: the network must still recover consistent 3D structure from the remaining cross-view interactions. Training under varying connectivity patterns therefore discourages excessive reliance on particular view pairs and encourages each frame representation to retain more geometrically informative context.
blocks.zh: 为此,我们引入了Maced几何编码器(MGE),这是一个灵活的框架,用于在向导3D基础模型中学习强健的几何表示. MGE从蒙面代表学习(He等,2022年)和师生学习(Caron等,2021年;Oquab等,2023年)中获得灵感. 与其掩盖图像内容,不如在全球关注期间随机去除相框到相框的连接,将现有的交叉视图信息限制在几何编码器来模拟稀有的校正视图图. 重要的是,基本场景几何学保持不变:网络仍然必须从剩余的交叉视图互动中恢复一致的立体结构. 因此,在不同的连通模式下进行的培训不会过分依赖特定的对视图,并鼓励每个框架代表保留更多的几何信息背景。

blocks.en: To supervise learning under incomplete context, we employ a self-distillation strategy that maintains geometric knowledge from the pretrained base model to MGE. Instead of relying on direct ground-truth supervision, which can be sparse (as shown in the Appendix A.1 ), we align the masked student with the teacher at two complementary levels: intermediate geometric features and predicted geometry. The feature-level objective encourages the student to preserve the teacher’s geometric representation despite reduced cross-view access, while the output-level objective constrains its resulting 3D predictions including point maps and camera poses. Consequently, MGE learns to recover the same underlying geometry from different subsets of cross-view evidence, promoting representations that remain stable when individual view relations are missing or unreliable.
blocks.zh: 为了在不完全的环境下监督学习,我们采用了一种自我消化策略,从预先训练的基模型到MGE,保持几何知识. 我们不依靠直接的地真相监督,这种监督可能很稀少(如附录A.1所示),而是将蒙面学生与教师在两个互补的层次:中间几何特征和预测几何。 地物分级目标鼓励学生保留老师的几何表达,尽管交叉视图的取用减少,而输出分级目标则会限制其由此产生的3D预测,包括点图和相机平面. 因此,两性平等部学习从不同分集的交叉视图证据中恢复同样的几何基础,促进在个人观点关系缺失或不可靠时保持稳定的表述。

blocks.en: Finally, we connect this robust representation learning objective to efficient long-sequence inference through an Anchor-Guided Adaptive (AGA) token-merging strategy. Token merging ( Bolya et al., 2022 ) reduces inference cost by combining similar or redundant tokens before global attention. Since MGE learns richer and more independent per-frame representations, it enables more effective merging than standard token-merging strategies ( Shen et al., 2025 ) . During inference, AGA uniformly selects a sparse set of full-resolution anchor frames and use their features to estimate the redundancy of the remaining views. Non-anchor frames are then assigned adaptive merging ratios according to their similarity to the anchor context, such that highly redundant views are compressed more aggressively while complementary views retain more tokens. Compared to standard token merging, our approach leads to significant performance improvement. The advantage is especially pronounced when neighboring views are farther apart, where uniform token reduction ( Shen et al., 2025 ) can discard geometric information and cause severe reconstruction degradation, whereas our method better preserves full-token performance.
blocks.zh: 最后,我们将这一强有力的代表性学习目标与高效的长期序列推论联系起来,方法是通过一个 " 指向适应性 " (AGA)象征性的结合战略。 Token合并(Bolya等,2022年)通过将类似或多余的代币合并到全球关注之前来降低推论成本. 由于两性平等部学习了更丰富、更独立的框架表述方式,因此比标准象征性合并战略(Shen等,2025年)更能有效地合并。 在推论期间,AGA统一选择了一套稀少的全分辨率锚定框,并利用其特性来估计剩余视图的冗余. 非锁定框架则根据它们与锚地环境的相近性分配适应性合并比率,这样,高度冗余的视图被更严格地压缩,而补充性视图则保留了更多的符号。 与标准符号合并相比,我们的做法导致显著的业绩改善。 当邻里观点更加相去甚远时,这种优势尤其明显,统一象征性的减少(Shen等人,2025年)可以丢弃几何信息并造成严重的重建退化,而我们的方法则能更好地保存完整的性能。

blocks.en: To summarize, our contributions are as follows: 1. We introduce MGE, which uses random frame-feature dropping within global attention to train feedforward 3D multi-view encoders under incomplete cross-view context. 2. During MGE training, we apply a self-distillation design from a pretrained base model through intermediate-feature and geometry alignment, providing supervision beyond sparse geometric ground truth that degrades performance. 3. Building on the robust representations learned by MGE, we propose AGA token merging, achieving better reconstruction quality than existing token-merging methods at a comparable computational cost, particularly in limited-view regimes. 4. We perform large scale experiments and demonstrate that MGE is significantly more robust and accurate in challenging evaluation settings such as occlusions, and doppelgangers compared to previous SoTA, while retaining top performance in conventional evaluations.
blocks.zh: 总之,我们的贡献如下: 1. 我们引入了MGE,它在全球关注范围内使用随机帧地平面投放,在不完全的交叉取景背景下训练向导3D多视图编码器. 2. 在两性平等培训期间,我们通过中间地貌和几何对接,从预先训练的基模型中采用自沉设计,提供超出稀有几何地面真实度的可降解性能的监督。 3. 根据专家组获得的有力陈述,我们提议AGA代号合并,以可比的计算成本,特别是在有限视角制度中,实现比现有代号合并方法更好的重建质量。 4. 我们进行大规模实验,并表明,与以往的 " 综合评价 " 相比, " 管理评价 " 在挑战性评价环境,如 " 隔离 " 和 " 二重身 " 方面,强而准确得多,同时保留了传统评价中的最高性能。

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Traditional structure-from-motion pipelines such as COLMAP ( Schönberger and Frahm, 2016 ) estimate camera poses through pairwise feature matching ( Sun et al., 2021 ; Edstedt et al., 2024 ; Edstedt et al., 2025 ; Shao et al., 2026 ) , geometric verification, and bundle adjustment. These pipelines naturally form a view graph , where edges encode reliable geometric relations between image pairs. The quality of this graph is critical: incorrect connections caused by visually similar but geometrically unrelated views can lead to erroneous camera estimates and corrupted reconstructions. A line of work therefore focuses on identifying and removing unreliable pairwise relations before geometric optimization. Doppelgangers ( Cai et al., 2023 ) and Doppelgangers++ ( Xiangli et al., 2025 ) , for example, detect visually ambiguous image pairs and prune spurious view-graph edges. These studies show that dense connectivity is not necessarily desirable: selectively restricting cross-view interactions can improve geometric consistency.
blocks.zh: COLMAP等传统结构起动管(Schönberger和Frahm,2016年)通过对等特性相配来估计相机所形成的相机(Sun等,2021年;Edstedt等,2024年;Edstedt等,2025年;Shao等,2026年),几何校正,并捆绑调整. 这些管道自然形成一个视图图,其中边缘编码了图像对之间的可靠的几何关系. 此图的质量至关重要:由视觉相近但几何不相干的观点所引发的不正确的连接会导致相机错误估计并破坏重建. 因此,一行工作的重点是在几何优化之前确定和消除不可靠的对等关系。 二进制 (Cai等,2023年)和多倍体++. (Xiangli等,2025年) 例如,检测出视觉模糊的图像对和粗糙的取景-图边. 这些研究表明,密集的连接不一定是可取的:有选择地限制交叉视图交互可以提高几何一致性.

blocks.en: Recent methods replace explicit correspondence construction and geometric optimization with learned geometric prediction. DUSt3R ( Wang et al., 2024 ) regresses dense pointmaps from uncalibrated image pairs, while MASt3R ( Leroy et al., 2024 ) augments this formulation with learned descriptors and matching supervision. Moving beyond pairwise prediction, VGGT ( Wang et al., 2025a ) jointly estimates cameras, depth, pointmaps, and tracks from multiple images, whereas CUT3R ( Wang et al., 2025b ) maintains a recurrent scene representation for continuous geometric perception. In these models, pairwise geometric relations are no longer explicitly represented as view-graph edges, but are instead implicitly encoded through learned global attention. This shifts the robustness problem from selecting geometric constraints before optimization to learning how information should propagate across views.
blocks.zh: 最近的方法用所学到的几何预测取代了明确的函证构造和几何优化. DUST3R(Wang等,2024年)从未校正的图像对上递回了密集点图,而MAST3R(Leroy等,2024年)则用已学得的描述符和相配监督来增强这种配方. VGGT(Wang等人,2025年a)超越对等预测,联合估算相机,深度,指针,和多幅图像的轨迹,而CUT3R(Wang等人,2025年b)则保持了连续几何感知的经常性场景表现. 在这些模型中,对等几何关系不再被明确作为取景-图边来表示,而是通过学到的全球关注来隐含地编码. 这把强性问题从选择几何限制到优化到学习信息如何传播各种观点。

blocks.en: Subsequent feed-forward approaches have also explored different organizations of multi-view inference. GLUEMAP ( Pan et al., 2026 ) combines local feed-forward reconstruction with global SfM, VGGT-Long ( Deng et al., 2025 ) processes views in overlapping subsets, and Diversity-aware VGGT ( Park et al., 2026 ) partitions views according to visual and spatial diversity. These approaches modify which views interact or how their predictions are combined at inference time. In contrast, MGE targets the learned interaction itself, training the geometric encoder under restricted cross-view connectivity so that its representation remains robust to missing or unreliable view relations.
blocks.zh: 随后的反馈法也探索了多种观点推论的不同组织. GLUEMAP(Pan等,2026年)结合了本地的饲料向前重建与全球SfM,VGGT-Long(Deng等,2025年)在相重叠子集中处理视图,而多样性-有意识的VGGT(Park等,2026年)根据视觉和空间多样性进行分区视图. 这些方法修改了哪些观点相互影响,或如何在推论时将其预测结合起来。 相比之下,MGE针对的是所学到的互动本身,在受限制的交叉视图连接下对几何编码器进行培训,以便其代表性仍然坚固到缺失或不可靠的视图关系.

blocks.en: Existing approaches scale reconstruction through joint prediction, incremental memory, and compressed attention. Fast3R predicts globally aligned geometry from large image collections, while Spann3R and MUSt3R accumulate cross-view information through spatial or multi-layer memory ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Wang and Agapito, 2025 ; Cabon et al., 2025 ) . FlashVGGT and VGGT- Ω \Omega reduce cross-view computation through compact descriptor or scene tokens ( Wang and Xu, 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Other methods modify inference without retraining: STAC compresses the key–value cache for streaming reconstruction, while HTTM and FastVGGT reduce computation through token merging ( Wang et al., 2026c ; Wang et al., 2026d ; Shen et al., 2025 ) . These methods improve scalability through architectural compression, memory management, or inference-time token reduction, with some also improving reconstruction quality. MGE complements these directions by explicitly learning geometric representations that remain reliable under partial cross-view connectivity, and AGA subsequently exploits this property to compress redundant frames adaptively during inference.
blocks.zh: 现有方法通过联合预测、增量内存和压缩注意力来扩大重建规模。 Fast3R从大型图像集中预测出全球对齐的几何,而Spann3R和MUSt3R则通过空间或多层内存来积累交叉视图信息(Yang等,2025;Wang和Agapito,2025;Cabon等,2025). FlashVGGT和VGGT - ship \Omega通过紧凑的描述符或场景符号来减少交叉视图计算(Wang和Xu,2026;Wang等,2026b). 其他方法在不进行再培训的情况下修改推论:STAC压缩用于流中重建的密钥-值缓存,而HTTM和FastVGGT则通过符号合并来减少计算(Wang等,2026c; Wang等,2026d;Shen等,2025.). 这些方法通过建筑压缩,内存管理来提高可扩展性,或者通过推论时间代号的减少来提高可扩展性,有些方法还提高了重建质量. MGE通过明确学习在部分交叉视图连接下仍然可靠的几何表达法来补充这些方向,AGA随后利用这个属性在推论中以适应性的方式压缩冗余帧.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminary: Multi-View Encoder in Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步:Feed-Forward 3D重建中的多维编码器

blocks.en:
Recent feed-forward 3D foundation models ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Keetha et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026e ) follow an encoder–decoder formulation. Given a set of N N input images ℐ = { I i } i = 1 N \mathcal{I}=\{I_{i}\}_{i=1}^{N} , an image encoder, such as DINOv2, first maps each image into a sequence of visual tokens 𝐗 i ∈ ℝ M × d \mathbf{X}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{M\times d} , where M M is the number of tokens per image and d d is the feature dimension.
A multi-view encoder then alternates between frame attention and global attention for L L layers. Frame attention updates tokens independently within each image, while global attention jointly processes tokens from all views: 𝐅 i l = SelfAttn frame ( 𝐆 i l ) , 𝐆 l = SelfAttn global ( [ 𝐅 1 l ; … ; 𝐅 N l ] ) , l = 1 , ⋯ , L , \mathbf{F}_{i}^{l}=\operatorname{SelfAttn}_{\mathrm{frame}}(\mathbf{G}_{i}^{l}),\quad\mathbf{G}^{l}=\operatorname{SelfAttn}_{\mathrm{global}}\left([\mathbf{F}_{1}^{l};\ldots;\mathbf{F}_{N}^{l}]\right),\quad l=1,\cdots,L, (1) where 𝐆 i 1 = 𝐗 i \mathbf{G}_{i}^{1}=\mathbf{X}_{i} . The output 𝐆 l \mathbf{G}^{l} is partitioned into per-frame representations { 𝐆 i l } i = 1 N \{\mathbf{G}_{i}^{l}\}_{i=1}^{N} ,and used as the input to the next frame attention layer.

blocks.zh: 3.2 遮盖几何编码器

blocks.en: Global attention provides unrestricted cross-view information flow in conventional 3D foundation models; however, prior works ( Arandjelovic et al., 2016 ; Cai et al., 2023 ; Xiangli et al., 2025 ) in camera calibration have demonstrated that eliminating certain cross-view pairs from bundle adjustment can be beneficial. In dense acquisition, many cross-view pairs are redundant, while some pairs can be harmful due to ambiguous features. By removing these pairs from a view graph, we can obtain better efficiency and higher performance.
blocks.zh: 全球关注在常规3D基础模型中提供了不受限制的交叉视图信息流;然而,先前的相机校正作品(Arandjelovic等,2016;Cai等,2023;Xiangli等,2025)表明从捆绑调整中去除某些交叉视图对可能是有益的. 在密集的获取中,许多交叉视图的对子是多余的,而一些对子可能由于模糊的特征而有害. 通过从视图图中去掉这些对子,我们可以获得更好的效率和更高的性能.

blocks.en: 3.4 Anchor-Guided Adaptive Token Merging
blocks.zh: 3.4 锁定-引导可适应合并

blocks.en: A key challenge for 3D foundation models is the quadratic cost of global attention, which limits scalability to long image sequences. Existing methods typically reduce this cost through token-level compression ( Shen et al., 2025 ; Wang and Xu, 2026 ; Shu et al., 2026 ) . However, token-level similarity does not necessarily imply geometric redundancy. Repetitive structures, such as windows on a building facade, may produce similar features and thus be merged into a single token despite corresponding to different 3D locations. Aggressive token merging can therefore remove spatially distinct geometric evidence. To better preserve scene structure, we introduce Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging (AGA) to compress at the frame level instead of token level.
blocks.zh: 3D基础模型的一个关键挑战就是全球关注的四重成本,它将可扩展性限制在长图像序列上. 现有方法一般通过符号级压缩来降低这一成本(沈等,2025;王和徐等,2026;舒等,2026. 然而,符号级的相近性并不一定意味着几何冗余. 倒置的结构,如建筑物外观上的窗户,可能会产生相近的特征,因此尽管与不同的3D位置相对应,但还是被合并成单一的代号. 因此,主动式符号合并可以去除空间上截然不同的几何证据. 为了更好地保存场景结构,我们引入了Anchor-Guided适配符合并(AGA)来进行帧级的压缩,而不是符级.

blocks.en: 4.3 Robustness to Visual Ambiguity
blocks.zh: 4.3 强健到视觉模糊

blocks.en: Visual ambiguities, i.e., regions with similar appearance but different geometric locations, often disrupt camera calibration. Since no official multi-view Doppelganger benchmark exists, we build a camera-pose benchmark under visual ambiguities from Heinly et al. (2014) , using COLMAP reconstructions with Doppelgangers++ ( Xiangli et al., 2025 ) as pseudo ground truth. The benchmark contains 43 subsets, each consisting of 15 geometrically consistent reference views and 5 visually similar but geometrically inconsistent “Doppelganger” views. Each feed-forward model processes all 20 images jointly in a single forward pass. We also include LoFTR ( Sun et al., 2021 ) as a traditional matching-based baseline, which estimates correspondences independently for each image pair and then performs geometric verification, triangulation, and global pose optimization.
blocks.zh: 视觉模糊,即外观相近但几何位置不同的区域,经常会干扰相机校正. 由于没有官方的多视图多双版基准,我们用从海因利等人(2014年)获得的视觉模糊度构建相机拥有基准,使用COLMAP重建多双版++ (Xiangli等,2025年)作为伪地真理. 该基准包含43个子集,每个子集包括15个几何相通的参考观点和5个视觉相通但几何相通的"二重身"观点. 每个向前进的模型在一次前传中共同处理所有20个图像. 我们还将LoFTR(Sun等,2021年)作为传统的以匹配为基础的基线,它独立地估计每对图像的对应,然后进行几何校验,三角测算,并进行全球姿势优化.

blocks.en: 4.4 Robustness to Occlusion

blocks.en:
We evaluate occlusion robustness on ETH3D ( Schops et al., 2017 ) , progressively corrupting 10%/30%/50% views using a centered white patch to formulate small/medium/large occlusion scenarios. We evaluate dense reconstruction and camera pose under increasing levels of occlusion, considering both full-attention and token-merging methods.
Table 2 shows that our method performs best under medium and large occlusion. As occlusion increases from clean to large, VGGT and π 3 \pi^{3} suffer 119% and 128% increases in accuracy error, respectively. Their fast variants show smaller relative degradation, but start from substantially worse reconstruction quality because of token merging and therefore remain less accurate overall. In contrast, our masked cross-view training improves representation robustness: the point accuracy error increases by only 48%, while pose estimation even improves by 4% under heavy occlusion. AGA further benefits from this robustness by retaining more tokens from less-occluded views, leading to a smaller performance drop as occlusion becomes more severe.

blocks.en: We evaluate different merging designs on ETH3D ( Schops et al., 2017 ) , which contains many low-texture and repetitive regions. Starting from the FastVGGT-style baseline, we replace uniformly protected tokens with uniformly sampled anchor frames, and then further introduce adaptive frame-wise merging. All variants retain the same overall token ratio for a fair comparison. As shown in Table 4.6 , anchor-frame protection substantially improves reconstruction quality over token-level protection, while adaptive merging provides additional gains. Comparing AGA to both VGGT and MGE weights, the marginal gains show that the representations learned by MGE are more robust to aggressive frame-level compression.

All variants are trained with the same optimization budget, and intermediate checkpoints are evaluated to compare convergence. Figure 4 shows that direct supervision converges more slowly and yields consistently higher reconstruction error. Pseudo supervision improves both convergence and reconstruction quality, while feature supervision further narrows the gap to the teacher.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we presented a masked geometric encoder for improving the robustness and efficiency of feed-forward 3D reconstruction. By randomly masking frame-to-frame connections during fine-tuning, the model is encouraged to recover consistent geometry from incomplete cross-view communication and to rely less on individual, potentially misleading interactions. A teacher-guided distillation strategy preserves the geometric capability of the pretrained model while enabling more efficient optimization of the masked student. At inference time, we further exploit the resulting frame-level redundancy through anchor-guided adaptive token merging, preserving complete anchor views while allocating token budgets according to cross-view redundancy.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了一个遮盖几何编码器,以提高向导3D重建的稳健性和效率. 通过在微调时随机地遮盖相框连接,鼓励该模型从不完整的交叉视图通信中恢复相容几何,并减少对个体,可能误导的相互作用的依赖. 由教师指导的蒸馏策略保留了被预先训练的模型的几何能力,同时能使被蒙面的学生得到更有效的优化. 在推论中,我们通过锚地制导的适应性标志合并,进一步利用由此产生的帧级冗余,保留完整的锚地视图,同时根据跨视图冗余分配符号预算.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments show that MGE preserves dense-teacher reconstruction quality while improving robustness to occlusion and visually ambiguous Doppelganger views. AGA further improves long-sequence efficiency, especially in low-texture and repetitive scenes. Together, these results demonstrate that regularizing cross-view connectivity is an effective way to improve the robustness and scalability of feed-forward 3D foundation models.
blocks.zh: 广泛的实验表明,两性平等部保留了密集的教师重建质量,同时提高了隔离和视觉上模棱两可的观点的稳健性。 AGA进一步提高了长序效率,特别是在低纹和重复的场景中. 这些结果共同表明,使交叉视图连接规范化是提高向导3D基础模型的稳健性和可扩展性的有效途径.

We initialize the weights for the encoder and the alternating attention module from the pretrained teacher model, and we keep the encoder frozen during training. For our loss function, we set the weights for

This stage converges rapidly and has no impact on the model’s overall performance.

blocks.en: We refer to the resulting model as MGE-VGGT and evaluate it on the ETH3D occlusion benchmark. As shown in Table 6 , MGE-VGGT remains close to the original VGGT under the clean setting and becomes increasingly better as the occlusion level increases. blocks.zh: 我们把由此产生的模型称为MGE-VGGT,并按ETH3D的隔离基准来评价. 如表6所示,MGE-VGGT在清洁环境下仍然接近原有的VGGT,随着隔离水平的提高而变得越来越好. 就密集重建而言,VGGT的精度误差从0.149从清洁到大封装从0.327,而MGE-VGGT则从0.158增加到0.287. 在完整性方面也有类似趋势。

blocks.en: The difference is more pronounced for camera pose. Under large occlusion, MGE-VGGT reduces ATE from 0.898 to 0.805 and RPE-r from 4.673 to 2.111 compared with VGGT. While the two models perform similarly under clean and small occlusion, VGGT degrades rapidly under medium and large occlusion, whereas MGE-VGGT remains relatively stable. These results show that the robustness brought by masked cross-view training also transfers to VGGT, despite its different architecture and prediction heads, suggesting that MGE is not specific to our default π 3 \pi^{3} teacher.
blocks.zh: 相机姿势的区别比较明显. 在大封装下,与VGGT相比,MGE-VGGT将ATE从0.898降至0.805,RPE-r从4.673降至2.111. 虽然这两种模式在清洁和小隔离下也表现类似,而VGGT在中和大隔离下迅速降解,而MGE-VGGT则保持相对稳定. 这些结果显示,蒙面交叉视图培训带来的强性也转移到了VGGT,尽管其架构和预测头不同,这表明MGE并不是我们默认的\\ 3\ pi\ 3}老师所特有的.

blocks.en: A.5.1 Benchmark
blocks.zh: A.5.1 基准

blocks.en: We first run COLMAP with Doppelgangers++ to obtain pseudo ground-truth camera poses and scene structure. For each scene, we identify an anchor pair with low normal-pair probability and negligible COLMAP covisibility, which defines two visually similar but geometrically separated sides of the scene. Starting from one anchor, we construct a 15-view reference set using farthest-point sampling over COLMAP camera centers. Reference views are required to be consistent with the reference side and geometrically connected to the selected set. We then sample 5 Doppelganger views from the opposite side, choosing views that are visually similar to the reference set but geometrically inconsistent with it. To reduce redundancy, we remove duplicate or highly overlapping subsets and manually verify the retained samples. This procedure produces 43 subsets, each containing 15 reference views and 5 Doppelganger views.
blocks.zh: 我们先用多双版++运行COLMAP,以获得伪地真相机的姿势和场景结构. 对于每个场景,我们确定一对锚对,正常-pair概率低而可忽略不计的COLMAP可视性,这定义了场景的两个视觉相近但几何相分离的侧面. 从一个锚开始,我们构建一个15个视角的参考集, 利用最远的点采样 在COLMAP相机中心。 需要参考视图与参考方一致,并与所选集几何相接. 然后我们从相反的一面抽取了5个二重身视图,选择与参考集视觉相近但与参考集几何不一致的视图. 为了减少冗余,我们删除了重复或高度重叠的子集,并手动核实所保留的样本. 这个程序产生了43个子集,每个集包含15个参考视图和5个二重身视图.

blocks.en: We provide the detailed metrics in Table 7 which are visualized in Figure 3 . Our method consistently outperforms existing long-sequence baselines across different keyframe strides. The advantage is especially pronounced under sparse keyframe sampling, where our model achieves substantially lower reconstruction errors and higher normal consistency than TTT3R, StreamVGGT, and FastVGGT. As the sequence becomes denser, our method remains robust and continues to deliver the best or comparable performance across all metrics. Notably, StreamVGGT runs out of memory for denser settings, whereas our method scales to all evaluated strides. We have a favorable balance between reconstruction quality and long-sequence scalability.

blocks.en: We further compare random masking with Sliding-Window Attention (SWA) during masked training. The corresponding mask patterns are visualized in Figure 8 , with comparable masking ratios used for a fair comparison. We evaluate both strategies on NRGBD ( Azinović et al., 2022 ) using keyframe strides of 100 and 10, representing limited- and redundant-view settings, respectively. As shown in Table A.8 , random masking consistently outperforms SWA under both settings, with a larger advantage for denser sequences. We attribute this to the limited propagation range of local sliding windows: similar to sequential matching, information must be relayed through intermediate views, whereas random connectivity enables more diverse long-range interactions and better approximates exhaustive multi-view reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在蒙面训练期间,我们进一步将随机蒙面与滑行-温道关注(SWA)进行比较. 相应的口罩图案在图8中可视化,可比较的口罩比用于公平比较. 我们利用100个和10个关键框架,分别代表有限和多余的视角,对NRGBD(Azinović等,2022年)的两个战略进行评估。 如表A.8所示,在这两种情况下,随机遮盖的性能始终高于SWA,对更密集的序列具有更大的优势. 我们将此归因于局部滑动窗口的传播范围有限:与相继相匹配类似,信息必须通过中间视图来传递,而随机连接则能够使远程互动更加多样并更近似于详尽的多视图推理.

blocks.en: Figure 9 presents qualitative reconstruction results on the 13 ETH3D scenes of our MGE+AGA and FastVGGT. Compared with FastVGGT, our method generally recovers more complete scene geometry while maintaining a coherent global structure. The improvement is particularly visible in challenging scenes such as courtyard, delivery area, and relief 2, where FastVGGT produces missing regions or disconnected fragments, whereas our reconstruction preserves a larger portion of the observed surfaces.
blocks.zh: 图9显示了我们MEGE+AGA和FastVGGT13个ETH3D场景的质量重建结果. 相较于FastVGGT,我们的方法一般恢复更完整的场景几何,同时保持了连贯的全球结构. 这种改善在诸如庭院、送货区和救济2等具有挑战性的场景中特别明显,在这些场景中,FastVGGT产生缺失区域或断开的碎片,而我们的重建则保留了所观测到的地表的较大部分。
